patterns.note: Full-width sections alternate between very dark and light backgrounds, with content consistently constrained to a central maximum width, creating a strong visual rhythm.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings, highly legible body text, and smaller, often uppercase, sub-labels for categories and navigation.
The site predominantly uses a high-contrast palette of near-black and white, accented by subtle cool-toned blues and a vibrant purple-to-blue gradient in the footer and background elements.
The initial hero section features a full-bleed video that plays and scrolls out of view, while the main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the page scroll.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, frequently utilizing grid layouts for showcasing work and insights, and expandable accordion components for detailed principles or services.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero section incorporates an autoplaying video with an overlaid play button and text, which is designed to scroll away to reveal the subsequent content sections.
A persistent navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, ensuring continuous access to site links as the user scrolls down the page.
Visual segmentation is achieved by alternating between very dark (near-black) and light (off-white) background colors for major content sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder (~3-5x body text) with generous line height, while body text is highly legible, and sub-labels are often smaller and uppercase.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant across most elements, including images and content cards, with only a very subtle radius on buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing is used between major sections and within the hero, transitioning to a balanced density for content within cards and text blocks.

standout: The site distinguishes itself with a sophisticated, almost cinematic aesthetic, driven by its high-contrast dark theme, full-bleed video hero, and the elegant use of a modern sans-serif typeface. The overall impression is one of high-end design and intellectual authority, avoiding common marketing site tropes through its refined visual language and sparse, impactful content presentation.
